exchangeDetails.name: Bybit
exchangeDetails.description: Bybit is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange registered in British Virgin Islands. Is Bybit safe? Bybit security rating is medium with 88% security score.

topRisks.content: The absence of CCSS certification leaves crypto custody controls unvalidated, increasing the risk of undetected security gaps.
Without a Proof of Reserve audit, user asset backing cannot be independently verified, elevating transparency and solvency risks.

The password policy is updated, requiring stronger passwords and improving overall account security.
The HTTP headers score is improved, adding better protections against common web attacks.
